walkthroughs.body_html:
Formulae & Equations — a core area of GCSE Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Formulae & Equations brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Formulae & Equations.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which term is defined as: “Shows the elements and number of atoms in a substance.”?
Which term is defined as: “Has equal numbers of each atom on both sides.”?
Which term is defined as: “(s), (l), (g) and (aq) show the physical state.”?
Which term is defined as: “Total mass of reactants equals total mass of products.”?
Which term is defined as: “The sum of the relative atomic masses in a formula.”?
Which term is defined as: “Charged particles formed when atoms gain or lose electrons.”?
